title: Fazon judge plan (format version 0)
description: The judge calls the harness derives for one component from its spec and story manifest: one call per question, theme and batch of at most 20 images. See docs/spec/judge.md.

question.description: The question's ID; a derived question's ID says what it was derived from. `change-<story>` carries the story's name, with its `--` separators.

source.description: `derived` by the harness, or from the spec's `judge` field.

kind.description: `each`: every image is judged on its own. `compare`: the images are judged against each other.
A story's capture, its committed baseline, the diff between them, the spec's reference image, or another component's baseline.

label.description: What the prompt calls the image; the judge's result names it.
